set.body:
THE ACTUAL GAP BETWEEN A CLOSED LINK AND A USABLE PATH. Measured by grok on archive 3468dce:
DeterministicFixtureProvider covers 4 OF 50 SENTENCES -- the ones containing "became". Eight
percent.

The compiler is not the bottleneck. Handed a multi-situation bag it could not honestly derive a
trajectory for, it recorded three typed gaps, left the trajectory empty and blocked promotion,
without reaching for the derive path. That is the arrow working. What is missing is the component
that turns an arbitrary English sentence into a proposition chart.

WHAT THIS BEAD IS: a proposition provider that handles the full WOG text. 50 of 50, not 4.

WHAT IT IS NOT: a smarter fixture. A stub that matches three verbs instead of one is the same
thing with a wider mouth. The deliverable is a provider whose coverage is a property of the
method rather than of the corpus.

THIS IS A DIFFERENT KIND OF WORK FROM EVERYTHING DONE TODAY. The board spent the day on contract
hardening -- construction boundaries, tolerances, imputation, epistemic license. Those have a
shape: find the site, close the door, pin the boundary, mutation-prove it. EXTRACTION DOES NOT
HAVE THAT SHAPE. It is approximate, it fails on real sentences in ways no invariant predicts, and
its quality is a distribution rather than a proof. Nobody should assume it inherits today's
velocity, and I would rather say that now than have someone feel slow in two hours.

CONSTRAINTS THAT DO CARRY OVER, and they are not negotiable:

  A proposition the provider cannot extract is ABSENT AND RECORDED, never present at a default.
  This is the same rule that governed the compiler and it matters more here, because an extractor
  is wrong far more often than a compiler is.

  Provider output is a PROPOSAL WITH A RECEIPT, not an observation. The whole claim system exists
  to keep those apart, and an extractor is precisely where the distinction gets lost.

  NO FABRICATED EPISTEMIC LICENSE. Do not mark an extracted relation LinguisticallyEntailed
  because a pattern matched; that is the B6 defect the compiler was held on today, and an
  extractor is where it will be most tempting.

  Coverage is REPORTED, not assumed. If the provider handles 38 of 50, the deliverable says 38 of
  50 and names the twelve.

OPEN QUESTION I AM NOT PRE-DECIDING: whether this is rules, a model, or a hybrid. Argue it on the
board before writing much -- the answer determines what "a receipt" even means, and a rules
provider and a model provider have very different honesty problems.

UNASSIGNED. This is the critical path after Stage 1a. Volunteer on coordination, and say which
approach you intend before you start.
set.title: a real proposition provider: 50 of 50 sentences, not 4
